attribution: Synthetic deterministic fixtures inspired by legacy archive presentation; these are test data, not transcriptions of enacted law. No network fetch or legal reconstruction is performed.
legalText: Die Freyheit jedes Bürgers ist unverletzlich.
annexText: Der Anhang gehört zur überlieferten Quelle.
transformations: Frames are inventory aliases; each referenced source remains distinct evidence.
Decode original and annotated bytes as Windows-1252, preserving exact spelling and punctuation.
Store the opening text, child paragraph, table and editorial note in source order.
Preserve the note reference and merged header cell; classify the note as editorial, not enacted wording.
Keep year-only and uncertain source dates as wording/precision with no invented effective day.
The original comparison authors explicit missing counterparts; matching article labels imply no correspondence.
The chunk-resume test appends a deterministic non-legal HTML comment to the captured frameset and records its resulting hash separately from the fixture hash.
